text: 我的评价是虚空对线。
en: My verdict is a pointless online confrontation.

text: 经典问题“你愿意让你的妻儿去卖嘛？
en: Classic question: 'Would you be willing to let your wife and children go and sell themselves?'

text: ”，有的加一个前提，万不得已。
en: ’, some add a premise—only as a last resort.

text: 那我们往前看30年，东北大下岗的时候，有个叫“丈夫在门外等”。
en: Then, looking back 30 years to the great lay-offs in the Northeast, there was one called 'The Husband Waiting Outside'.

text: 在万不得已情况下，已经发生过的事实都可以否定，有什么好辩论的
en: Under a situation where there is no alternative, facts that have already come to pass can all be denied—what is there to debate?

text: 性交易非法很正常
en: It is perfectly normal for sex work to be illegal.

text: 性交易合法虽然违背公序良俗但也不罕见
en: Although legalising sex work violates public morals and good customs, it is not uncommon either.

text: 罕见的是：性交易部分合法
en: What is rare is: the partial legalisation of sex work.

text: 你不禁彩礼和包养，不禁拿钱砸的所谓恋爱关系，不禁各种行业潜规则。
en: You do not prohibit bride prices and kept mistresses, you do not prohibit so-called romantic relationships bought with money, you do not prohibit the various unspoken rules of different industries.

text: 然后，禁止卖淫嫖娼？
en: Then, you prohibit prostitution?

text: 合着老百姓花不起大钱的违法，老爷们掏金山银山买的合法？
en: So the ordinary folk who cannot stump up large sums are acting illegally, while the big shots who splash mountains of gold and silver buy themselves legality?

text: 那这就不是道德问题而是阶级问题了，一个阶级问题我为什么要站着剥削我的那一部分人的立场上讲话呢？
en: Then this is not a moral question but a class question. Since it is a class question, why should I speak from the standpoint of those who exploit my own people?

text: 至少经过管处和56学姐那破事之后，按照扫黄派的逻辑，体操是比卖淫更亟待禁止的行业
en: At the very least, after that business with Chu Guan and 'Senior 56', by the logic of the anti-vice faction, gymnastics is an industry more urgently in need of prohibition than prostitution.

text: 我还真从同事哪儿听过一个故事，真假不知。
en: I actually did hear a story from a colleague once—whether true or false I cannot say.

text: 下属子公司有个销售，日常和同事聊天过程中，鼓吹卖淫合法，因为他经常陪同客户出入风月场所，当然想合法化，没有后顾之忧。
en: A salesperson at a subsidiary company, in the course of everyday chats with colleagues, advocated legalising prostitution, because he often accompanied clients in and out of entertainment venues, and of course wanted legalisation, free of any worries.

text: 但后面发生了回旋镖，他家姑娘大学放假，闲来无事，瞒着家人和朋友一起去了我们这一量贩KTV做收银临时工（下午场，很空），KTV表面非常正规，但，只要是老客户，钱到位了，经理就会私下为客户联系“出门”服务。
en: But then a boomerang effect set in: his daughter, home from university for the holidays with nothing to do, hid it from her family and went with friends to a local hourly-rate KTV to do temp cashier work (afternoon shifts, very quiet). The KTV looked perfectly legitimate on the surface, but—so long as it was a regular customer and the money was right—the manager would privately arrange 'out-call' services for the client.

text: 有天来了个老客户，暗示经理看上了收银，就要她，经理实在推脱不过，就问姑娘愿不愿意，眼神暗示她说不同意，姑娘没见过这场面，吓得直接下班回家告诉了她爸。
en: One day an old customer came, hinted to the manager that he had taken a liking to the cashier, and demanded her. The manager really could not refuse, so he asked the girl whether she was willing, with a look that signalled her to say no. The girl had never seen such a situation; frightened, she finished her shift, went home and told her father.

text: 从此她爸切换阵营，坚决反对合法化，称他们一家也不是富裕家庭，他姑娘靠道德挡得了一时，万一真被人砸五千一万甚至更多，很难保证不走弯路。
en: From then on her father switched sides and firmly opposed legalisation, saying their family was not a wealthy one either; his girl could rely on morality to hold things off for a while, but if someone really threw five or ten thousand or even more at her, it would be hard to guarantee she would not go astray.

text: 因此，还是要看，是否利益相关。
en: Therefore, it still comes down to whether one's interests are at stake.

text: 谁说现在卖不合法了，不是还有结婚吗
en: Who says selling oneself is not legal now—isn't there still marriage?

text: 有没有人解释一下这个“拥抱费”啊？
en: Can anyone explain this 'hug fee'?

text: 我对这个事算不上支持或者反对，但是之前在一个群里有人讨论过，反对卖淫合法的几个人一直强调一点 : 卖淫一旦合法了，很多人就会被逼迫去卖淫。
en: I would not call myself supportive or opposed on this matter, but it was discussed in a group before: several people against legalising prostitution kept stressing one point: once prostitution is legalised, many people will be forced into prostitution.

text: 你以为到时候你是嫖别人，实际你会变成被嫖的。
en: You think you will be the one patronising others, but in reality you will become the one being patronised.

text: 我说 : 那我问一句，现在足疗是合法的吧？
en: I said: then let me ask—foot massage is legal now, isn't it?

text: 群里有谁或者听说过谁被逼迫去当足疗技师吗？
en: Has anyone in the group, or has anyone heard of anyone being forced to become a foot-massage therapist?

text: 群里沉默了。
en: The group fell silent.

text: 卖淫绝对不能合法化！
en: Prostitution must absolutely never be legalised!

text: 前几天我在一个种子网站爬了一个专业探花人，他的商业模式估计是：偷拍探花视频去卖钱进而变成嫖资的循环互利模式！
en: A few days ago I scraped a professional 'tanghua' on a torrent site; his business model is probably this: secretly film tanghua videos to sell for money, which then turns into a circular, mutually beneficial model of prostitution funds!

text: 我发现搜关键词全是这个人的脸，搜出来4000多条bt数据，每个人大概在2500到4/5000左右！
en: I found that searching the keyword turned up nothing but this person's face; the search returned over 4,000 pieces of BT data, each person roughly between 2,500 and 4,000–5,000!

text: 去掉重复的数据，这个人估计约了上千个小姐姐！
en: Removing duplicate data, this person probably met over a thousand 'young ladies'!

text: 我发现这些小姐姐一个比一个漂亮，有的还有男朋友！
en: I found these young ladies were prettier one than the next, and some even had boyfriends!

text: 身材好，皮肤好，腿长，有个性！
en: Great figures, great skin, long legs, real personality!

text: 这些小姐姐放在平时周围肯定是女神级别的，周围一大堆舔狗，彩礼最起码八十八万八起步！
en: These young ladies, in everyday life, would definitely be goddess-level, surrounded by a heap of simps, with a bride price starting at no less than 888,000!

text: 所以我不支持卖淫合法化，有钱人帅的人享福让我们这些恐艾人嫉妒羡慕恨！
en: So I do not support legalising prostitution—the rich and handsome get to enjoy themselves while we, who fear AIDS, are left green with jealousy, envy and resentment!

text: 这里的真正问题是——为什么反对卖淫合法的人，口口声声宣称卖淫合法是对女性的物化和不尊重，但却不肯尊重一下现实中真正自己在代表自己发声的卖淫女的意见？
en: The real question here is—why do those who oppose legalising prostitution, who keep declaring that legal prostitution is the objectification and disrespect of women, refuse to respect the views of actual sex workers who truly speak for themselves in reality?

text: 下文为欧洲性工作者工会正在努力争取的权益：
en: The following are the rights that European sex workers' unions are striving to secure:

text: 劳动权益保护：性工作者应该被承认为劳动者，获得劳动合同，工作条件的改善。
en: Labour rights protection: sex workers should be recognised as workers, obtain employment contracts, and see improvements in working conditions.

text: 社会保障：性工作者能够缴纳税款，获得退休金等社会福利。
en: Social security: sex workers should be able to pay taxes and receive social welfare such as pensions.

text: 反对污名歧视和压迫：性工作者不受歧视，不因职业而被视为罪犯，最终引发来自警方的暴力对待。
en: Opposing stigma, discrimination and oppression: sex workers are not discriminated against, are not regarded as criminals on account of their occupation, and are ultimately not subjected to violent treatment by the police.

text: 建立安全工作环境和健康权益：改善安全工作环境、减低职业风险，提高从业者的健康保护水平。
en: Establishing a safe working environment and health rights: improve the safe working environment, reduce occupational risk, and raise the level of health protection for those in the trade.

text: 反对强迫卖淫：区分自愿性工作者与强迫卖淫，将被强迫卖淫的人解救出来。
en: Opposing forced prostitution: distinguish voluntary sex workers from forced prostitution, and rescue those who are forced into it.

text: ——你们不尊重现实中真实存在的女性，而只是在复读你们嘴里的一系列教条，却告诉我们“你们才是真正尊重女性的人”？
en: —You do not respect the women who truly exist in reality; you merely parrot a series of dogmas from your own mouths, yet tell us 'you are the ones who truly respect women'?

text: ——事实上，你们根本就不是在尊重女性，你们只是把现实中活生生的女性作为你们表演“尊重女性”人设的道具，比起卖淫合法化来说，这才真叫“物化女性”呢…
en: —In fact, you are not respecting women at all; you are merely using real, living women as props for performing your 'respecting women' persona. Compared with legalising prostitution, this is what truly deserves to be called 'the objectification of women'…

text: 反驳不了。
en: Cannot be refuted.

text: 答案看到很多反驳论调，都反驳不了。
en: Answer has seen many rebuttal arguments, none of which can be refuted.

text: 首先是性病论。
en: First, the sexually transmitted disease argument.

text: 卖淫绝对不是最主要途径。
en: Prostitution is absolutely not the primary route.

text: 有意识的都会保护好赚钱工具，没意识的刚好更需要合法化来培训监管保护。
en: Those with awareness all protect their money-making tool; those without awareness are precisely the ones who more need legalisation to provide training, regulation and protection.

text: 合法后更有利于疾控。
en: After legalisation it would be more conducive to disease control.

text: 我国是绝对有能力控制疾病传播的，这点大家都不质疑吧。
en: Our country absolutely has the capacity to control the spread of disease; surely no one disputes this.

text: 其次是合法迫害女性论。
en: Next, the argument that legalisation persecutes women.

text: 合法了那就更多强迫了？
en: If it's legal, then there'd be more coercion?

text: 强迫他人劳动了解一下，非法监禁了解一下。
en: Coerced labour of others—ever looked into it? Illegal imprisonment—ever looked into it?

text: 合法肯定是更保障权益啊，怎么会更非法呢？
en: Legalisation surely offers more protection of rights—how could it be more illegal?

text: 黑工厂会比正规工厂更尊重人权？
en: Would an unlicensed factory respect human rights more than a proper one?

text: 那建议取缔所有合法行业。
en: Then I suggest abolishing all legal industries.

text: 再其次是买卖人体器官论。
en: Next after that, the buying and selling of human organs argument.

text: 那公司雇你打字是不是买你的手？
en: Then when a company hires you to type, is it buying your hands?

text: 或者买你的脑子？
en: Or buying your brain?

text: 工作和性究竟谁对人体器官危害大？
en: Between work and sex, which does greater harm to the body's organs?

text: 然后是人格尊严论。
en: Then, the personal dignity argument.

text: 当鸡和当狗谁更有尊严？
en: Between being a prostitute ('chicken') and being a dog, which has more dignity?

text: 母狗就合法，那想必人格尊严保住了。
en: Being a 'bitch' is legal, so presumably personal dignity is safe.

text: 出轨滥交变成性自由时尚单品，忠贞变成封建流毒，哪边现在才是人格尊严？
en: Cheating and promiscuity become fashionable items of sexual freedom, while fidelity becomes feudal poison—which side now represents personal dignity?

text: 人格尊严这种道德层面主观且易变的东西，法律怎么定？
en: Personal dignity is something subjective and changeable at the moral level—how can the law define it?

text: 至于说愿不愿意家人当鸡，那你愿不愿意家人捡垃圾？
en: As for whether you'd want your family to be prostitutes, would you want your family to collect rubbish?

text: 那擦边女主播呢？
en: Then what about the risqué female streamers?

text: 无非是职业歧视，跟合法性讨论没有关系。
en: It is nothing but occupational discrimination, unrelated to the discussion of legality.

text: 最后是社会危害总论。
en: Finally, the general argument on social harm.

text: 有什么危害是现在非法情况下无法达成的吗？
en: Is there any harm that cannot already be achieved under the current illegal situation?

text: 家庭破坏？
en: Destroying families?

text: 性病？
en: STDs?

text: 忠贞消失造成的。
en: Caused by the disappearance of fidelity.

text: 体质下降？
en: Decline in physical constitution?

text: 撸导致的。
en: Caused by masturbation.

text: 成瘾性？
en: Addictiveness?

text: 倾家荡产？
en: Losing one's entire fortune?

text: 这种人打个游戏都能倾家荡产，性还有cd，而且倾家荡产还能比的上赌结婚？
en: This sort of person could lose their whole fortune just playing a video game; sex at least has a cooldown, and can ruin you anywhere near as much as gambling on marriage?

text: 涉黑？
en: Involvement with organised crime?

text: 那本来就是打击对象。
en: That is already a target of crackdowns.

text: 道德滑坡？
en: Moral decline?

text: 都到这里了还能怎么滑？
en: We've already come this far—how much further can it slide?

text: 还有人觉得捞女比鸡有道德？
en: And there are still people who think a gold-digger has more morals than a prostitute?

text: 这一切甚至合法化后会有所改善。
en: All of this would even improve after legalisation.

text: 到最后卖淫不能合法的理由只有公序良俗说这不好，那公序良俗现在都快烂完了，就剩一点惯性了。
en: In the end, the only reason prostitution cannot be legal is the claim that it violates public morals and good customs; but public morals are already nearly rotten through, with only a bit of inertia left.

text: 说到底就是制定法律的人没想到道德滑这么快，钱货两讫都成道德标兵了。
en: When all is said and done, it is simply that those who make the laws did not expect morality to slide so fast—even a clean cash-for-goods transaction has become a paragon of virtue.

text: 也许有一天后人看婚姻合法而卖淫非法会觉得不可思议也说不定。
en: Perhaps one day, future generations looking at marriage being legal while prostitution is illegal will find it inconceivable too.
